blocks.x: Cash-flow underwriting for MSME lending, approval rate up 14 points at a flat delinquency rate, decision time from nine days to 36 hours

A tier-2 universal bank: Banking margins live between risk and speed: approve too slowly and the customer leaves, approve too fast and the losses follow. The Achala program started where that tension is sharpest —. The baseline signed in week two made the cost visible in units the finance team already owns, and the engagement ran under the standard Achala charter — a named metric, a named control owner and gates that evidence every move.
The baseline read the funnel honestly: 63% of MSME applications died in documentation chase, and of the approvals that survived, a third were priced by judgment calls no one could reconstruct.

GST filings and cash-flow data existed but reached the credit memo as PDFs a human retyped. Two applicants with identical bank statements could receive opposite decisions depending on which branch handled them.

We built the underwriting stack around retrieval and evaluation: GST, statement and bureau signals extracted into a structured cash-flow view, a decision memo drafted by the system with every number cited to its source document, and an evaluation harness that measured memo quality before any underwriter saw it. Underwriters approve with the citations attached.
